verdict.rationale: Tavily documents a real bulk operation: Extract accepts a batch of up to 20 URLs in one request and reports successes and per-URL failures separately. Crawl and Map also cover many pages at once, exploring hundreds of paths in parallel from a single call. missing for 10: batch support for other operations such as multi-query search, bulk limits beyond the 20-URL extract cap, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior.
